		has_ports = yes
	}
	allow = {
		oe_react_can_anti_piracy_patrol = yes
		gold >= 100

	ai_will_do = {
		value = 0

			limit = {
				gold >= 300

		}
	}
	illustration_tags = { 10 = exterior }
	option = {
		name = oe_react_dec_anti_piracy_patrol.a

			set_variable = { name = oe_react_dec_patrol_cd years = 10 }
			add_gold = -100

		}
